blurb: Blue Knuckles Sport Fishing offers private 6-pack charters for deep sea fishing in Monterey Bay and off the Big Sur Coast. Trips target species like king salmon, rockfish, lingcod, halibut, bluefin tuna, and albacore tuna. The boat departs from Moss Landing Harbor, close to rich fishing grounds including Monterey Canyon.
